title: Chapter 889
paragraphs: Chapter 889
Episode 222. Yona's Observation (2)
(Boovar and Ainas found the Ant King!)
(Orugal went to meet the enemy tribe.)
(There is a guy called Dream Demon King, named Pirobex Bahma. He's strong, sharp, and has something called a dream ability.)
(Ainas is Pirobex's daughter, she has the potential for dream abilities surpassing Pirobex. However, she wants to wield a sword like Bianca Caligo. However, she really has no talent for the sword.)
(Pirobex got information through a dream that Elona was hurt. He plans to go back into Elona's dream to rescue other Dream Demons trapped there soon.)
(It seems he has also been in contact with Kellyak t
hrough dream abilities. It looks like Ainas went into Kellyak's dream once. Pirobex pleaded with her. It seems Ainas's ability is also necessary to enter the dream of Rokia Ganesto?)
(Marjiella has gone berserk. It looked like a huge emergency.)
Runkandel, The Garden of Swords.

Those gathered in the meeting room marveled again and again as they read Yona's report. In this world, the only person who could infiltrate Kincelo's meeting room and extract such information was just one person, Yona.
"Yona has brought some great information. Dream Demon King Pirobex Bahma, and dream abilities....”
Dream abilities.
Of course, the Bamel Alliance had never even imagined such a thing. From the beginning, much wasn't known about the powers and privileges of the demon race.
"Did our ancestors who went through the Holy Kingdom Defense War not know anything about dream abilities?"
[Precisely, we don't know. But there are parts that are hinting.]

[During the Holy Kingdom Defense War, we felt that our strategies were constantly being leaked to the enemies. At that time, we did everything we could to identify a spy, but in the end, we found nothing. So, we guessed that there might be some kind of prophet among the demons... but it seems like it might have been the dream ability.]
When Alpen and Tasha spoke, Lret nodded.

[A thousand years ago, the Dream Demons caused chaos among the people. The knights of our family lost their minds from having nightmares because of them. But I didn't know they could even check the information known by the subject through dreams...]
[Huh, wasn't even Elona Jipul, the star magician, unable to prevent the dream demons from infiltrating? That means if that Dream Demon King guy wants to, he can enter all of our dreams.]

[However, among the information that Yona brought, there are also the existences of the dream demons that were caught in the dream. It means there is some level of risk associated with the Dream Demons using their dream abilities. But it's headache inducing. If not even Elona can prevent it, it means it's only a matter of time before all our information is exposed.]
Lret and Ballass said.
"'It's a matter of time', but it may not be that simple, Head Servant. If it were so easy to obtain information using dream powers, Orgal would not have been stabbed in the back so often by me."
"Ah, I see your point."

"Furthermore, although Elona Zipple is a Creation Mage, as Ameris-nim once said, she did not become one through training and awakening. Hence, her capacity to guard her consciousness, her will, may be somewhat lacking. That's probably why they infiltrated Elona's dreams instead of Veradine's. However, considering that they infiltrated Kelliac's dreams as well, I'm not quite sure."

"Come to think of it, a thousand years ago, the knights with outstanding willpower were less tormented by nightmares. Maybe Ainas Caligo's dream power exceeds that of Pirovski because she is superior? According to the report, it appears that Pirovski cannot enter Kelliac's dream alone without the help of Ainas."
"That makes sense. Ainas Caligo... was she another special case like Bubar? There was also mention of needing Ainas's power to glimpse into the dreams of Rokia Ganesto."
"Grandson, let's set aside the dream powers of that Ainas for now. The fact that they infiltrated the dreams of Kelliac and Rokia could mean they know their locations, right?"

"Of course, that's possible, great-grandfather. However, if they knew their exact locations, there's a higher chance that Orgal would have tried to make direct contact. Just like he's meeting the enemy tribe right now. Alternatively, even if they don't know the location, they might be able to infiltrate if they have something related to them... We can only speculate for now."

Especially, Orgal had a great grudge against Rokia Ganesto. If he knew where Rokia was, he would surely have tried to kill or capture her, and there was a high chance he would have asked for Jin's help in the process.
"Knowing the enemy has a special power, it's frustrating not to have a good way to deal with it. Hmm, Head Servant, do you have any clever ideas?"
"I don't know how to completely block dream intrusions. However, I suggest that Valeria and I check our colleagues' records daily."
"Oh! You mean to check if there were any dream intrusions daily?"
"That's right."
"While it might infringe on privacy, it seems to be the best method for now, as long as dream power can't override record magic."

"Record magic, at its extreme, can reveal even Zipple's historical manipulation. There is no reason that a mere demon's power would not appear in the records. Of course, this work will be easier once the mass-production type of Red Owl is completed. At present, Valeria and I can't travel all over the union every day."
"The mass production type of the Red Owl seems to be delayed because Dr. Kwaul spends most of his time on the barrier... but it should be completed soon."
"If possible, I think we should definitely secure Ainas Caligo in the future."

"That's right. For now, there's no point in disturbing Ainas needlessly. We're already overwhelmed with the demon world, and there's no need to antagonize sturdy pawns. Not just Ainas, but even Bubar Gaston, those two are key personnel of Kinselo."
That's how the discussion about dealing with dream powers concluded.
"The reason Orgal went to meet the enemy tribe is obvious. Trade. They lived in the same era in ancient times, so there's a high chance Orgal
has information that the enemy tribe needs."

After it was revealed that he was one of Ameris's heads, Zephirin has regained some of his ancient memories. Since he even knew about the destruction of the Protection Wall which Ameris had forgotten, it was a foregone conclusion that Orgal had information for trade with the enemy tribe.
"Trade... So they could potentially form an alliance, right? My great-grandson."

"Kinselo is unlikely to rashly form an alliance with the enemy tribe. Their ideologies differ to begin with, and Kinselo might feel uncomfortable completely turning their back on Zipple in this situation. If Kinselo forms an alliance with the enemy tribe, it would be one of two possibilities. Kinselo has a formidable hidden card, or the enemy tribe possesses a means to beat Zipple."
Both are not impossibilities, but Jin almost entirely excluded the chance of them forming an alliance.

"Also, it's obvious why Kinselo is attempting to contact Kelliac. Kelliac is now in a difficult situation, like a fallen hero, so they'd want to recruit him as an ally. From Kelliac's perspective, depending on Kinselo might not be so bad. Coming to Rune Kandel or returning to Zipple are both non-options. Of course, the possibility of him joining forces with the enemy tribe, the royal family, or the demon world can't be excluded."
However, for now, Kelliac was a character who could potentially be a significant card for Jin.
-[His fire and mine are polar opposites. However, essentially they are the same fire, so I have this thought that I may be able to manifest myself using him.]
-Through Shino's power... I'll first look into Shino to prepare for the war with the demon world, Tes. Since Shino tried to trade with me, we might communicate well.
A conversation Jin had with Tes not long ago.
Therefore, Jin wanted to secure Kelliac first and foremost. Accepting him as a member of the alliance is impossible, but they can utilize each other's necessary parts.
The Barmel Alliance has been tracking Kelliac's location since encountering Shino, but so far, there has been no significant progress.
"We have no choice but to rely on Sister Yona again to find Kelliac's whereabouts. If Sister continues to monitor Ainas, some clues might emerge."
Now, there was only one thing to discuss regarding the information brought by Yona.
Marziella Iveliano.
The younger sister of Bishukel, a character whose intentions are unknown and whose abilities have not been clearly identified.

"Marziella has gone berserk... and even Pirovski Bahma left his seat immediately despite sensing someone hiding in the conference room. This means Marziella is a significant figure within Kinselo. And Pirovski was probably the only person who could control Marziella's rampage at the time."
Jin has felt for a while that Marziella is an extremely important person in Kinselo. In the absence of Orgal and Zephirin, Marziella often appeared in the place of Kinselo.
[It seems she controls through that dream power.]
[I wonder why she went berserk and what happens when she does. But Head Servant, I have a feeling that Marziella's rampage has something to do with the demon world.]
Although the Barmel Alliance didn't know, Marziella once had a massive rampage due to a psychic attack from the monstrous deity. The reason for Marziella's current rampage was likely similar.
"I think the same, Head Servant. Do you remember what I said when Orgal came to support the barrier?"
[Yes, I remember. You said that there is something in Kinselo right now that should not be seen by the demon world. So they intentionally sent reinforcements to the barrier.]
Jin's eyes narrowed.
"I think that something might be the existence of Marziella Iveliano. It would be good to ask Tilius and Misol about her the next time we meet them."
